summary.text: Cody Hutcheson is a Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 123 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Hutcheson is a retired U.S. Air Force veteran who served from 2004 to 2024 and who said in a Ballotpedia survey that a "People First" approach to representation is central to the campaign.

paragraphs.text: Cody Hutcheson, also known as Hutch, graduated from Notre Dame Regional High School and served in the U.S. Air Force from 2004 to 2024.
Hutcheson earned an associate degree from Air University in 2024 and is retired.
Hutcheson advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Hutcheson described the campaign as centered on listening to constituents and respecting voter-approved policies such as minimum wage increases and paid sick leave.
Hutcheson also named rising living costs, rural health care access, public education, protection of waterways and expansion of high-speed fiber internet as priorities.
